content.title: Celebrity Jeopardy All-Stars season 4 quarterfinals with Mina Kimes, Andy Richter airs tonight
content.text: A new episode of "Celebrity Jeopardy! All Stars" will air on Friday, April 3 on ABC (photo courtesy of ABC News on YouTube).ABC NewsIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Ariana Tourangeau | atourangeau@masslive.comThe “Celebrity Jeopardy! All-Stars” contestants featured in the quarterfinals on Friday, April 3, are Mina Kimes, Andy Richter and Timothy Simons. The new episode will air at 8 p.m. ET on ABC. Those without cable can watch the show for free through FuboTV or DIRECTV, each of which offers a free trial to new users. Sling is another option for streaming the show and promotional offers are available.Hosted by Ken Jennings, “Celebrity Jeopardy! All-Stars” features the best and brightest celebrity players from the first three seasons returning to the stage to battle for $1 million for a charity of their choice.The season 4 quarterfinals feature Mina Kimes, Andy Richter and Timothy Simons.
